description.zh: 光学笔记第二篇的六节：从1845年法拉第发现磁场使偏振面旋转开始，经菲佐用旋转齿轮测光速、韦伯与科尔劳施比较静电与电流的磁作用，麦克斯韦由场方程解出电磁波并把光认定为电磁波，再到赫兹用火花隙实验产生、接收并反射这些波，用麦克斯韦方程的边界条件解释薄膜干涉的半波损失，最后从热腔辐射的压强与模式计数导出斯特藩—玻尔兹曼律和瑞利—金斯公式，并指出经典能量均分无法给出有限的热辐射谱。
description.en: The six sections of the second optics note: from Faraday's 1845 discovery that a magnetic field rotates the plane of polarization, through Fizeau's rotating-gear measurement of the speed of light and the Weber–Kohlrausch comparison of electrostatic and magnetic measurements, and Maxwell's field equations yielding electromagnetic waves and the identification of light as one, to Hertz's spark-gap experiments that generated, received, and reflected those waves; the boundary conditions of Maxwell's equations explaining the half-wave loss in thin-film interference; and finally thermal-cavity radiation, where radiation pressure and mode counting lead to the Stefan–Boltzmann law and the Rayleigh–Jeans formula, and classical equipartition cannot give a finite thermal-radiation spectrum.

text.zh: 1. 磁场怎样改变光：1845
text.en: 1. How a Magnetic Field Changes Light: 1845

text.zh: 波动理论已经能计算出许多干涉、衍射和偏振现象的细节，但承载光振动的以太究竟是什么，仍然没有明确的答案。托马斯·杨（Thomas Young）在19世纪初曾猜想，传递电作用与承载光振动的可能是同一种以太，并提出通过电作用改变液体折射的实验来检验这一猜想。迈克尔·法拉第（Michael Faraday）也尝试用电和磁影响光的传播。1845年，他发现，磁场能使穿过透明介质的光改变偏振方向，为光与磁之间的联系提供了实验证据[2, §6.2]。
text.en: The wave theory could already account for many details of interference, diffraction, and polarization, but what the ether that carries light vibrations actually was remained without a definite answer. In the early nineteenth century Thomas Young had conjectured that the ether transmitting electrical action and the ether carrying light vibrations might be one and the same, and he proposed an experiment on changing the refraction of a liquid by electrical action to test this conjecture. Michael Faraday also tried to influence the propagation of light by electricity and magnetism. In 1845 he found that a magnetic field can change the polarization direction of light passing through a transparent medium, providing experimental evidence for a connection between light and magnetism [2, §6.2].

text.zh: 实验原理如图1所示。光依次通过起偏器、玻璃和检偏器。起偏器的透光轴沿 $x$ 方向，使通过的光沿 $x$ 方向振动；玻璃外的线圈通电后，在玻璃内产生沿光传播方向的磁场。检偏器的透光轴最初沿 $y$ 方向，与起偏器垂直。以下忽略玻璃的吸收，记到达检偏器的光强为 $I_0$、振幅为 $A$。
text.en: The principle of the experiment is shown in Fig. 1. Light passes in turn through a polarizer, a piece of glass, and an analyzer. The transmission axis of the polarizer lies along $x$, so that the transmitted light vibrates along $x$; once the coil around the glass is energized, it produces inside the glass a magnetic field directed along the propagation direction of the light. The transmission axis of the analyzer initially lies along $y$, perpendicular to the polarizer. In what follows we neglect absorption by the glass and denote the intensity and amplitude of the light reaching the analyzer by $I_0$ and $A$.

text.zh: 法拉第的实验表明，磁场能够通过介质改变光的偏振方向，光与磁之间确实存在联系。但这一发现还不足以说明光是什么。要进一步建立光的电磁理论，还需要研究电磁作用如何传播。
text.en: Faraday's experiment showed that a magnetic field can change the polarization direction of light through a medium, and that a connection between light and magnetism indeed exists. But this discovery was not yet sufficient to say what light is. To go further and build an electromagnetic theory of light, one must still study how electromagnetic action propagates.
2. The Speed of Light and Electrical Measurements: 1849–1857

text.zh: 1849 年以前，光速的量级只能由天体观测估计：罗默（Ole Rømer）1676 年从木星卫星食的时刻偏差断定光以有限速度传播，布拉德雷（James Bradley）后来由恒星位置的周年变化缩小了它的大致范围[1, §1.4]。要在地面上用几公里的距离直接测出光速，需要一只能在极短时间里反复开合的“快门”，因为光走完几公里往返只要约 $6\times10^{-5}$ s。1849 年，菲佐（Hippolyte Fizeau）在巴黎郊外做了这个测量[1, §1.4]。
text.en: Before 1849, the order of magnitude of the speed of light could only be estimated from astronomical observations: in 1676 Ole Rømer inferred from timing deviations in the eclipses of Jupiter's moons that light propagates at a finite speed, and James Bradley later narrowed its rough range from the annual variation in stellar positions [1, §1.4]. To measure the speed of light directly on the ground over a distance of a few kilometers required a “shutter” that could open and close repeatedly within an extremely short time, because light covers a round trip of a few kilometers in only about $6\times10^{-5}$ s. In 1849 Hippolyte Fizeau carried out this measurement outside Paris [1, §1.4].

text.zh: 装置沿一条直线排开：近端放着光源、观察用的望远镜、一块倾斜的半透半反镜和一只边缘开齿的轮子，远处的反射镜与近端相距 $L\approx8.6$ km（巴黎的苏雷纳到蒙马特，$8633$ m）。光源的光被半透半反镜折向轮子边缘，从齿与齿之间的缺口射出；光走过单程 $L$ 到达远处的镜子，原路返回，再从同一个齿轮的缺口穿过一次，然后透过那面镜子进入望远镜。
text.en: The apparatus was laid out along a straight line: at the near end were a light source, a telescope for observation, a tilted half-silvered mirror, and a wheel with teeth cut along its rim, while the distant mirror stood at a one-way distance $L\approx8.6$ km from the near end (from Suresnes to Montmartre in Paris, $8633$ m). Light from the source was deflected by the half-silvered mirror toward the rim of the wheel and emerged through the gap between two teeth; it traveled the one-way distance $L$ to the distant mirror, returned along the same path, passed once more through a gap in the same gear, and then entered the telescope through that mirror.

text.zh: 这个设计的关键，是让同一只齿轮两次控制光的通过：第一次把连续光切成一串光脉冲，第二次检验这些脉冲回来时齿隙是否仍然开放。光源虽然持续发光，经过齿轮射出的光却是断续的。光往返期间，轮子继续转动；调节转速，便能使返回的光脉冲与齿隙开放的时段重合或错开。人眼分辨不了每个短脉冲，在望远镜里看到的是它们的平均亮度。
text.en: The key to the design was to let the same gear control the passage of light twice: the first time it chopped the continuous light into a train of pulses, and the second time it tested whether the gaps were still open when those pulses returned. Although the source emitted light continuously, the light emerging past the gear was intermittent. While the light made its round trip, the wheel kept rotating; by adjusting its rotation rate one could make the returning pulses coincide with, or miss, the intervals when a gap was open. The eye cannot resolve each short pulse, so what was seen in the telescope was their average brightness.

text.zh: 设轮子有 $N$ 个齿和 $N$ 个齿隙，齿与齿隙等宽，每秒转 $f$ 圈。相邻两个齿隙先后到达光路的时间间隔为 $T=1/(Nf)$，每次开放持续 $T/2$。光的往返时间记为 $\tau=2L/c$，它不随轮子转速改变。
text.en: Let the wheel have $N$ teeth and $N$ gaps, with teeth and gaps equally wide, and let it rotate $f$ times per second. The time interval between two successive gaps arriving at the light path is $T=1/(Nf)$, and each opening lasts $T/2$. The round-trip time of the light is denoted $\tau=2L/c$; it does not change with the rotation rate of the wheel.

text.zh: 图2(b)–(d)的第一行画出齿隙开放的时段，第二行画出光往返一趟后回到齿轮的时段。回光只有赶上齿隙开放才能通过，因此第三行只保留前两行重叠的部分，表示最终进入望远镜的光。以下忽略光束宽度，并把轮齿视为完全不透光。
text.en: In Fig. 2(b)–(d) the first row shows the intervals when a gap is open, and the second row shows the intervals when light returns to the gear after one round trip. Returning light can pass only if it catches a gap open, so the third row retains only the overlap of the first two rows, representing the light that finally enters the telescope. In what follows we neglect the width of the light beam and treat the teeth as completely opaque.

text.zh: **较低转速：返回脉冲与开放时段仍有重叠。**
text.en: **Lower rotation rate: the returning pulse still overlaps the open interval.**

text.zh: 当 $\tau<T/2$ 时，返回脉冲的前一部分还能赶上齿隙开放，后一部分则被接着移来的齿挡住。图2(b)取 $T=4\tau$：齿隙每次开放 $2\tau$，返回脉冲与它重叠的时间只有 $\tau$，所以通过的脉冲变窄，平均亮度下降。转得更慢时，两行重叠更多，回光更亮。
text.en: When $\tau<T/2$, the leading part of the returning pulse still catches the gap open, while the trailing part is blocked by the tooth that arrives next. Figure 2(b) takes $T=4\tau$: each gap stays open for $2\tau$, and the returning pulse overlaps it for only $\tau$, so the transmitted pulses become narrower and the average brightness drops. At still lower rotation rates the two rows overlap more and the returning light is brighter.

text.zh: **首次消光：返回的亮段恰好遇到轮齿遮挡。**
text.en: **First extinction: the returning bright interval meets the teeth.**

text.zh: 转速增大到 $T=2\tau$（即 $T/2=\tau$）时，返回脉冲恰好错开齿隙的开放时段，如图2(c)。所有在齿隙开放时出发的光，回来时都被齿挡住；而返回时齿隙开放的那些时刻，对应的出发时刻又没有光通过。因此第三行始终为0，理想情况下完全消光。实际测量寻找的是回光亮度的极小值，有限光束宽度、杂散光和轮齿误差都会使这个最小值不为零。
text.en: When the rotation rate increases to $T=2\tau$ (that is, $T/2=\tau$), the returning pulse just misses the interval when the gap is open, as in Fig. 2(c). All light that set out while the gap was open is blocked by a tooth when it returns; and at the moments when the gap is open on the return, no light passed through at the corresponding departure time. The third row is therefore always 0, and ideal extinction occurs. An actual measurement looks for a minimum in the returning brightness; the finite beam width, stray light, and errors in the teeth all keep this minimum from being zero.

text.zh: **转速加倍：返回脉冲与下一个开放时段重合。**
text.en: **Doubling the rotation rate: the returning pulse coincides with the next open interval.**

text.zh: 此时周期缩短到 $T=\tau$，返回脉冲延迟了恰好一个周期，与当前齿隙的开放时段重新对齐，如图2(d)。每个返回脉冲都能通过，平均亮度恢复。继续提高转速，还会交替出现亮度极小和极大。
text.en: The period is now shortened to $T=\tau$, so the returning pulse is delayed by exactly one period and realigns with the interval when the current gap is open, as in Fig. 2(d). Every returning pulse passes, and the average brightness recovers. Raising the rotation rate further produces alternating minima and maxima of brightness.

In each column, from top to bottom, are the intervals when a gap is open (gray), the intervals when returning light reaches the gear (orange), and the light that finally enters the telescope (blue, the overlap of the first two rows). (b) Rotation rate $f_1/2$, $T=4\tau$: the rows partially overlap, the returning light is weakened, and the time-averaged transmission is $1/4$. (c) Rotation rate $f_1$, $T=2\tau$: the rows just miss each other, giving ideal extinction and an average of $0$; here $f_1=c/(4LN)$ is the rotation rate at which extinction first appears, with $N$ the number of teeth. (d) Rotation rate $2f_1$, $T=\tau$: the rows realign, the returning light recovers, and the average is $1/2$. The time average determines the brightness in the telescope, normalized here to the returning intensity when the gear does not block it.*

text.zh: 几年后，一组与光无关的电学实验给出了另一个可以写成速度的数。
text.en: A few years later, a set of electrical experiments unrelated to light produced another number that could be written as a speed.

text.zh: 19 世纪中叶，电学里有一个把静电测量和电流测量联系起来的问题：同一份电荷，用静电力去量，和用它放电时电流的磁效应去量，得到的两套数值相差多少？韦伯（Wilhelm Weber）和科尔劳施（Rudolph Kohlrausch）在莱比锡用一个莱顿瓶把这两种测量放在同一份电荷上[3, §2.4.8]。测量分两条路。
text.en: In the mid-nineteenth century, electricity posed a question connecting electrostatic and current measurements: how far apart are the two sets of values obtained for the same charge when it is measured by electrostatic force and when it is measured by the magnetic effect of the current during its discharge? In Leipzig, Wilhelm Weber and Rudolph Kohlrausch used a single Leyden jar to apply both kinds of measurement to the same charge [3, §2.4.8]. The measurement proceeded along two routes.

text.zh: **静电一路。**
text.en: **The electrostatic route.**

text.zh: 科尔劳施先用一只导体球接触莱顿瓶的内层导体，取走一部分电荷，再由接触前后瓶电压的变化定出球带走的电荷占瓶中原有电荷的几分之几。球上的电量放在库仑扭秤上测量。扭秤用细丝悬挂一根端部带小球的水平轻杆，被测电荷与秤内固定小球之间的电力使轻杆扭转，悬挂的细丝或石英丝产生的回复扭矩与它平衡；在扭转范围内，悬丝扭转的角度正比于所受扭矩，因此角度先经标定对应到力。知道作用力、两球间距，以及两球所带电荷的比例（由两球接触使电荷等分来控制），再由库仑定律
text.en: Kohlrausch first touched a conducting sphere to the inner conductor of the Leyden jar and removed part of the charge; from the change in the jar's voltage before and after contact he determined what fraction of the jar's original charge the sphere carried away. The charge on the sphere was measured with a Coulomb torsion balance. The balance hangs a light horizontal rod carrying a small ball at its end from a fine fiber; the electric force between the charge under test and a fixed ball in the balance twists the rod, and the restoring torque of the suspended fiber or quartz thread balances it. Over the range of twist, the angle through which the fiber twists is proportional to the torque applied, so the angle is first calibrated against force. Knowing the force, the separation of the two balls, and the ratio of their charges (controlled by touching the balls so as to divide the charge equally), one then uses Coulomb's law

text.zh: 就定出以静电力标定的电量。其中 $q_1$、$q_2$ 是两球所带电荷，$r$ 是球心间距，图3(a)标出了这三个量。
text.en: to determine the charge calibrated by electrostatic force. Here $q_1$ and $q_2$ are the charges on the two balls, $r$ is the separation of their centers, and Fig. 3(a) marks these three quantities.

text.zh: **电流一路。**
text.en: **The current route.**

text.zh: 同一只莱顿瓶通过一只自制的冲击电流计短促放电。放电电流在短时间内通过线圈，对线圈施以磁作用的冲量，使它带着指针或小镜摆动；第一次摆动的最大幅度正比于这个冲量，而冲量正比于放电电流对时间的积分 $\int I\,\mathrm dt$。这一步成立的假设是放电时间远短于电流计的摆动周期，放电结束前摆几乎来不及发生，整次放电因而可以当成一次瞬间冲量，最大偏转才直接对应 $Q=\int I\,\mathrm dt$。这样得到的电量以电流的磁作用标定。
text.en: The same Leyden jar was discharged in a brief pulse through a homemade ballistic galvanometer. For a short time the discharge current passed through the coil and gave it an impulse through magnetic action, setting it swinging together with a pointer or small mirror; the maximum amplitude of the first swing is proportional to this impulse, and the impulse is proportional to the time integral of the discharge current, $\int I\,\mathrm dt$. This step assumes that the discharge time is much shorter than the swing period of the galvanometer, so that the swing has barely begun before the discharge ends and the whole discharge can be treated as an instantaneous impulse; only then does the maximum deflection correspond directly to $Q=\int I\,\mathrm dt$. The charge obtained this way is calibrated by the magnetic action of the current.

text.zh: 两条路测的是同一个瓶里的同一份电荷，只是一个化成放电电流来量，一个化成静电电量来量；图3把这两条路线并排画出。
text.en: The two routes measured the same charge in the same jar, one by converting it into a discharge current and the other by converting it into an electrostatic charge; Fig. 3 shows the two routes side by side.

alt.zh: 同一份电荷的两种测法
alt.en: Two ways of measuring the same charge

text.zh: 库仑定律中的 $k_{\rm e}$ 表示静电作用的强度。电流的磁作用也有相应的常数 $k_{\rm m}$。对于两根平行长直导线，单位长度所受的磁力为
text.en: The constant $k_{\rm e}$ in Coulomb's law measures the strength of the electrostatic interaction. The magnetic action of a current has a corresponding constant $k_{\rm m}$. For two long parallel straight wires, the magnetic force per unit length is

text.zh: 如图3(c)，$I_1$、$I_2$ 分别是两根导线中的稳恒电流，$r$ 是两线间距，$F_{\rm m}$ 是长度为 $\ell$ 的一段导线所受的磁力。同向电流相互吸引，电流越大或间距越小，吸引力越强。这里用平行导线的简单几何来表示磁作用常数 $k_{\rm m}$；图3(b)实际放电回路中的电流则记为 $I(t)$。
text.en: As in Fig. 3(c), $I_1$ and $I_2$ are the steady currents in the two wires, $r$ is the distance between them, and $F_{\rm m}$ is the magnetic force on a segment of length $\ell$. Currents in the same direction attract each other, and the attraction is stronger for larger currents or smaller separations. The parallel wires are used here as a simple geometry to represent the constant of magnetic action $k_{\rm m}$; the current in the actual discharge circuit of Fig. 3(b) is written $I(t)$.

text.zh: 电流是单位时间通过截面的电量，稳恒电流满足 $I=Q/t$。由 $F_{\rm e}$ 的表达式，$k_{\rm e}$ 的单位是 $\mathrm{N\,m^2/C^2}$；由导线单位长度的磁力表达式，$k_{\rm m}$ 的单位是 $\mathrm{N/A^2}=\mathrm{N\,s^2/C^2}$。两者相除，力和电量的单位消去，只剩长度平方比时间平方：
text.en: Current is the charge passing through a cross section per unit time, and a steady current satisfies $I=Q/t$. From the expression for $F_{\rm e}$, the unit of $k_{\rm e}$ is $\mathrm{N\,m^2/C^2}$; from the expression for the magnetic force per unit length of the wire, the unit of $k_{\rm m}$ is $\mathrm{N/A^2}=\mathrm{N\,s^2/C^2}$. Dividing one by the other cancels the units of force and charge, leaving only a squared length over a squared time:

blocks.tex:
\left[\frac{k_{\rm e}}{k_{\rm m}}\right]
=\frac{\mathrm{m^2}}{\mathrm{s^2}},
\qquad
v_{\rm e}=\sqrt{\frac{k_{\rm e}}{k_{\rm m}} } .

text.zh: 韦伯与科尔劳施的测量结果对应的 $v_{\rm e}$ 约为 $3.11\times10^8$ m/s[3, §2.4.8]。
text.en: The measurements of Weber and Kohlrausch correspond to $v_{\rm e}$ of about $3.11\times10^8$ m/s [3, §2.4.8].

text.zh: 1857 年，基尔霍夫（Gustav Kirchhoff）从当时流行的电动力学理论出发，算出细导线上的电扰动以约 $3.1\times10^8$ m/s 传播，并记下它与真空中光速相符，没有多作解释[3, §2.5.4; 2, p. 240]。
text.en: In 1857 Gustav Kirchhoff, starting from the electrodynamic theory then current, calculated that an electric disturbance on a thin wire propagates at about $3.1\times10^8$ m/s, and noted that this agrees with the speed of light in vacuum, without explaining it further [3, §2.5.4; 2, p. 240].

text.zh: 菲佐用齿轮测出了光的往返时间，韦伯与科尔劳施比较了静电作用和电流的磁效应，基尔霍夫又把后者得到的电学参数与导线上电扰动的传播速度联系起来。这几项工作逐渐汇到同一个问题上：为什么从电学中得到的速度，会与光速如此接近？麦克斯韦随后建立的电磁理论，为这种接近给出了物理解释。
text.en: Fizeau measured the round-trip time of light with a gear, Weber and Kohlrausch compared the electrostatic interaction with the magnetic effect of a current, and Kirchhoff connected the electrical parameters obtained from the latter with the propagation speed of an electric disturbance along a wire. These works gradually converged on a single question: why should a speed obtained from electricity come so close to the speed of light? The electromagnetic theory Maxwell went on to build gave this closeness a physical explanation.
3. The Electromagnetic Theory of Light: 1861–1865

text.zh: 经过对以太力学模型的探索，麦克斯韦（James Clerk Maxwell）在1860年代把电与磁的规律统一到一套场的理论中。关键的一步，是在描述电流磁效应的方程中加入变化电场的贡献：变化的磁场与电场相联系，变化的电场也与磁场相联系。由此，他解出了能够在空间中传播的电磁波，并算出了它的传播速度[3, §§4.3.3, 4.4.6; 2, pp. 240–242]。
text.en: After exploring mechanical models of the ether, James Clerk Maxwell in the 1860s unified the laws of electricity and magnetism into a single field theory. The key step was to add the contribution of a changing electric field to the equation describing the magnetic effect of a current: a changing magnetic field is linked to an electric field, and a changing electric field is linked to a magnetic field as well. From this he solved for electromagnetic waves able to propagate through space and calculated their speed [3, §§4.3.3, 4.4.6; 2, pp. 240–242].

text.zh: 在没有电荷和电流的真空中，电场与磁场满足麦克斯韦方程：
text.en: In vacuum, with no charges or currents, the electric and magnetic fields satisfy Maxwell's equations:

text.zh: $\mathbf E$ 是电场强度（单位 V/m），$\mathbf B$ 是磁感应强度（单位 T），$\epsilon_0$、$\mu_0$ 是由电学测量定出的两个常数[4, §9.2.1]。两条散度方程说，在这片没有电荷的区域内，电场线与磁场线都没有源或汇；两条旋度方程说，变化的磁场在周围激起绕行的电场（法拉第电磁感应定律），变化的电场在周围激起绕行的磁场（安培定律加上麦克斯韦补上的那一项）。后两条把 $\mathbf E$ 和 $\mathbf B$ 缠在一起，取旋度可以把它们拆开。
text.en: $\mathbf E$ is the electric field strength (unit V/m), $\mathbf B$ is the magnetic induction (unit T), and $\epsilon_0$ and $\mu_0$ are two constants fixed by electrical measurements [4, §9.2.1]. The two divergence equations say that in this charge-free region the electric and magnetic field lines have no sources or sinks; the two curl equations say that a changing magnetic field excites a circulating electric field around it (Faraday's law of induction), and a changing electric field excites a circulating magnetic field around it (Ampère's law together with the term Maxwell added). The latter two entangle $\mathbf E$ and $\mathbf B$; taking a curl separates them.

text.zh: 把这组方程的解取为沿一个方向传播的平面波，两条散度方程要求电场和磁场都垂直于传播方向，两条旋度方程进一步要求二者彼此垂直，因此这是一列横波；图4画出它的电场、磁场与传播方向。
text.en: Taking the solution of these equations to be a plane wave propagating in one direction, the two divergence equations require the electric and magnetic fields to be perpendicular to the propagation direction, and the two curl equations further require them to be perpendicular to each other; it is therefore a transverse wave. Figure 4 shows its electric field, magnetic field, and propagation direction.

text.zh: 由于 $k_{\rm e}=1/(4\pi\epsilon_0)$、$k_{\rm m}=\mu_0/(4\pi)$，波速 $v=1/\sqrt{\mu_0\epsilon_0}$ 恰好等于电学测量中的 $v_{\rm e}=\sqrt{k_{\rm e}/k_{\rm m}}$。代入韦伯与科尔劳施的电学测量结果，得到约 $3.11\times10^8$ m/s；另一边，菲佐用齿轮与反射镜测出的光速约为 $3.15\times10^8$ m/s。前一个结果来自电荷与电流，后一个结果来自光的往返，两条独立路线得到的速度十分接近[3, §4.3.3]。
text.en: Since $k_{\rm e}=1/(4\pi\epsilon_0)$ and $k_{\rm m}=\mu_0/(4\pi)$, the wave speed $v=1/\sqrt{\mu_0\epsilon_0}$ is exactly the $v_{\rm e}=\sqrt{k_{\rm e}/k_{\rm m}}$ of the electrical measurements. Substituting the electrical measurements of Weber and Kohlrausch gives about $3.11\times10^8$ m/s; on the other hand, the speed of light measured by Fizeau with a gear and a mirror is about $3.15\times10^8$ m/s. The first result comes from charges and currents, the second from the round trip of light, and the two independent routes give speeds that are very close [3, §4.3.3].

text.zh: 电学理论算出的波速与独立测得的光速接近，这种波又具有偏振所要求的横向性（图4）。因此，光可能不是另一种恰好同速的波，光本身就是电磁波。此前不知道“光里究竟是什么在振动”，现在有了一个具体答案：电场与磁场[3, §§4.3.3, 4.4.6]。
text.en: The wave speed calculated from electrical theory is close to the independently measured speed of light, and this wave has the transversality that polarization requires (Fig. 4). Light therefore need not be another wave that merely happens to have the same speed: light itself is an electromagnetic wave. What had been unknown—what exactly was vibrating in light—now had a concrete answer: the electric and magnetic fields [3, §§4.3.3, 4.4.6].

text.zh: 如果光就是电磁波，那么电装置能不能也发出这样的波？当时还无法让电流振荡得像可见光那样快，但较慢的振荡应当产生波长更长的波。它们虽然看不见，却可以通过对另一套电装置的作用被探测到。
text.en: If light is an electromagnetic wave, could an electrical device also emit such waves? At the time it was impossible to make a current oscillate as fast as visible light, but slower oscillations should produce waves of longer wavelength. Although invisible, they should be detectable through their action on another electrical device.
4. Hertz's Experiment: 1886–1888

text.zh: 赫兹（Heinrich Hertz）要判别的，是亥姆霍兹（Hermann von Helmholtz）框架内哪一个电动力学方案成立，而不是直接测量光速；造波、检波和测量波长，构成了他在这一过程中发展出的一整套实验技术[3, §6.3.11, §6.4.1, §6.4.3–§6.4.6]。
text.en: What Heinrich Hertz set out to decide was which electrodynamic scheme within the framework of Hermann von Helmholtz was correct, not to measure the speed of light directly. In the process, he developed a suite of techniques for generating waves, detecting them, and measuring their wavelengths [3, §6.3.11, §6.4.1, §6.4.3–§6.4.6].

text.zh: 发射器是两段金属导体，中间留一道很窄的空隙，叫火花隙。鲁姆科夫（Ruhmkorff）线圈给导体充电，电压升到足以击穿空隙时，一道火花把两段导体接通，电荷在导体之间来回振荡，形成快速振荡的电偶极子，向空间辐射[3, §6.4.3; 1, §3.6.1]。
text.en: The transmitter consisted of two metal conductors separated by a very narrow gap, the spark gap. A Ruhmkorff coil charged the conductors; when the voltage rose enough to break down the gap, a spark connected the two conductors, and charge oscillated back and forth between them, forming a rapidly oscillating electric dipole that radiated into space [3, §6.4.3; 1, §3.6.1].

text.zh: 接收器是一段弯成环或拉成直线的导线，中间留一道极小的空隙，小到要在暗处才看得见火花。把它放到离发射器几米远的地方，如果辐射的电场在导线里推动电荷、在空隙两端积起足够高的电压，空隙就被击穿，出现一粒肉眼可见的小火花[3, §6.4.3; 1, §3.6.1]。看到小火花，只说明有一份电磁扰动到达了接收器所在的位置；它本身分不清近处的静电感应和远处的辐射，也不给出波长。赫兹进一步改变接收器的取向，并用金属板反射这些波，观察接收效果怎样随位置变化。
text.en: The receiver was a piece of wire bent into a loop or drawn out straight, with a very small gap in the middle, small enough that the spark could be seen only in the dark. Placed a few meters from the transmitter, if the radiated electric field drove charges in the wire and built up a high enough voltage across the gap, the gap broke down and a small spark visible to the eye appeared [3, §6.4.3; 1, §3.6.1]. Seeing a small spark shows only that some electromagnetic disturbance reached the position of the receiver; by itself it cannot distinguish the nearby electrostatic induction from the distant radiation, nor does it give the wavelength. Hertz went on to change the orientation of the receiver and to reflect these waves from a metal plate, observing how the received effect varied with position.

text.zh: **转动接收器，确定振动的方向。**
text.en: **Rotating the receiver to determine the direction of vibration.**

text.zh: 保持位置不变，绕自身轴转动接收器，火花的强弱随取向变化，某些取向下火花消失。接收器对电场和磁场都有耦合，不同几何下响应不一样；在合适的取向和距离上，火花主要由电场驱动。不能把任意取向的接收环都当成纯电场探针。
text.en: Keeping its position fixed and turning the receiver about its own axis, the strength of the spark varies with orientation, and in some orientations the spark disappears. The receiver couples to both the electric and magnetic fields, and its response differs with geometry; at a suitable orientation and distance, the spark is driven mainly by the electric field. Not every orientation of the receiving loop can be treated as a pure electric-field probe.

text.zh: **在对面立一块金属板。**
text.en: **Placing a metal plate on the opposite side.**

text.zh: 让发射的波和板面反射回来的波在板前叠加，形成驻波。
text.en: The emitted wave and the wave reflected from the plate's surface superpose in front of the plate, forming a standing wave.

text.zh: 赫兹不只量出波长。他让这些波反射、折射，用金属面把它们聚焦，转动接收器确定它们的偏振，并让入射波与反射波干涉出驻波[1, §3.6.1]。这些正是第一篇里光所表现的行为：光能反射、折射、偏振、干涉，而偏振说明光是横波。电产生的波逐条复现了这些性质，同一组方程对波长也不设上下限，从米量级一直到光波量级都适用。赫兹把这些波称为“波长很长的光线”，认为它们足以消除对光、辐射热和电磁波同一性的疑问[1, §3.6.1]。
text.en: Hertz did not only measure the wavelength. He made these waves reflect and refract, focused them with metal surfaces, rotated the receiver to determine their polarization, and made the incident and reflected waves interfere into a standing wave [1, §3.6.1]. These are precisely the behaviors light exhibited in the first note: light reflects, refracts, polarizes, and interferes, and polarization shows that light is a transverse wave. The waves produced by electricity reproduced these properties one by one, and the same set of equations sets no upper or lower limit on wavelength, applying from the meter scale all the way to the scale of light waves. Hertz called these waves “light rays of very long wavelength” and considered them sufficient to remove doubt about the identity of light, radiant heat, and electromagnetic waves [1, §3.6.1].

text.en: The convex surface of a plano-convex lens rests lightly on a flat glass plate, and between them an air film thickens outward from the point of contact. Under near-normal illumination with monochromatic light, concentric bright and dark rings appear in the reflected light, with a dark spot at the center; counting only the propagation phase difference $4\pi h/\lambda$ from the film thickness $h$ (where $\lambda$ is the wavelength in air), the point of contact $h=0$ should be brightest, contrary to observation. In 1802, discussing the dark center of light reflected from a thin bubble, Young added a rule: light reflected at an interface toward a medium of higher refractive index changes phase by $\pi$; pressing a liquid with refractive index between those of the lens and the plate into the film made the central spot brighten [2, §5.1, p. 182]. To derive this rule from electromagnetic theory, one needs to know what boundary conditions the interface imposes on the electromagnetic field.

6. Blackbody Radiation: 1859–1905

text.zh: 上一节把麦克斯韦方程的边界条件用在一块玻璃的表面上，解释了反射光为什么有半个周期的相移。同一组方程还可以用在一个完全不同的对象上：烧热的炉子。炉膛的壁维持在温度 $T$，壁上开一个小孔。射进孔里的光要在腔内来回反射多次才可能逃出，因此小孔既接近理想的吸收体，也接近理想的发射体；从孔里看进去，看到的是腔内处于热平衡的辐射。早在 1792 年，英国陶工韦奇伍德（Thomas Wedgwood）就注意到：窑里的物件无论大小、形状、材质，都和窑壁一起呈现同样的红色[1, §13.1.1, p. 613]。这个颜色只由温度决定，与物件本身无关。
text.en: The previous section applied the boundary conditions of Maxwell's equations to the surface of a piece of glass and explained why the reflected light acquires a half-period phase shift. The same set of equations can be applied to a completely different object: a heated furnace. The wall of the furnace chamber is held at temperature $T$, and a small hole is opened in the wall. Light entering the hole has to be reflected back and forth inside the cavity many times before it can escape, so the hole is close to both an ideal absorber and an ideal emitter; looking into the hole, one sees radiation in thermal equilibrium inside the cavity. As early as 1792, the English potter Thomas Wedgwood noticed that objects in the kiln, whatever their size, shape, or material, showed the same red color together with the kiln wall [1, §13.1.1, p. 613]. This color is determined by temperature alone and is independent of the objects themselves.

text.zh: 要让这件事可测量，让孔里漏出的光先经过一块不吸收光的棱镜，不同波长偏折到不同方向；探测器沿棱镜后面的弧线移动，每到一处只接收一个窄波段，读出单位时间、单位面积、单位波长间隔内进入探测器的能量[1, §13.1.1, pp. 613–614]。把读数对波长作图，得到一条先升后降的曲线：短波一侧几乎为零，随波长增大升到一个峰，过峰后缓慢下降。炉温升高，整条曲线抬高，峰向短波移动。这条曲线之所以值得从理论上推导，是因为基尔霍夫（Kirchhoff）在 1859 年得到一个普适性结论：处于热平衡的腔，壁的发射本领与吸收本领之比在每个波长上都与壁的材料、颜色、形状、大小无关，只依赖温度和波长[1, §13.1.1, pp. 612–613; 5, §1.1, pp. 1–2]。论证的要点是：若两个温度相同、壁材料不同的腔辐射不同，把它们连通，就会有能量从一方流向另一方，温度不再均匀，与热平衡矛盾。所以孔里漏出的谱只由 $T$ 决定，换炉子、换壁料都不改变。
text.en: To make this measurable, the light leaking from the hole first passes through a prism that does not absorb light, deflecting different wavelengths into different directions; a detector moves along an arc behind the prism, receiving only a narrow band at each position and reading off the energy entering the detector per unit time, per unit area, and per unit wavelength interval [1, §13.1.1, pp. 613–614]. Plotting the readings against wavelength gives a curve that first rises and then falls: it is almost zero on the short-wavelength side, rises to a peak as the wavelength increases, and falls slowly after the peak. As the furnace temperature rises, the whole curve is raised and the peak shifts toward shorter wavelengths. This spectrum is worth deriving theoretically because Kirchhoff arrived at a universal conclusion in 1859: for a cavity in thermal equilibrium, the ratio of the wall's emissive power to its absorptive power is, at every wavelength, independent of the wall's material, color, shape, and size, depending only on temperature and wavelength [1, §13.1.1, pp. 612–613; 5, §1.1, pp. 1–2]. The essential argument is that if two cavities at the same temperature but with different wall materials radiated differently, connecting them would make energy flow from one to the other; the temperature would no longer be uniform, contradicting thermal equilibrium. Hence the spectrum leaking from the hole is determined by $T$ alone, and changing the furnace or the wall material leaves it unchanged.
